summary.name: FlowPeek
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS menu-bar app that renders Mermaid diagram source as drawn diagrams wherever you find them, such as docs pages, pull requests, terminals and editors.
use_cases: Previewing Mermaid diagrams in docs pages without leaving the page
Rendering Mermaid blocks in pull request descriptions
Viewing Mermaid diagrams printed in Terminal, iTerm2 or Ghostty
Drawing diagrams from code in editors or coding agent sessions
Offline diagram rendering with no network requests
summary.what_it_does: FlowPeek is a macOS menu-bar app that draws Mermaid diagrams from their source text. You can select Mermaid text in any app and click a button that appears, or hold Option and point at a block and press Space. It also detects a copied diagram and shows a badge naming the key that opens it. In Terminal, iTerm2 and Ghostty it frames diagrams printed at the prompt or inside full-screen programs like vim or a coding agent. Mermaid is bundled, so rendering does not make network requests. Diagrams it draws are saved locally on the Mac for a shelf that can be capped by count, by age, or turned off.
notable: Renders Mermaid diagrams with no network requests since Mermaid is bundled
Works across apps: selection button, Option-hover, copy badge, terminal frames
Diagram shelf of previously drawn diagrams stored locally, with count/age limits or off
MIT licensed with no account or telemetry
caveats: Requires macOS Accessibility permission; declining it disables reading selected text, though copying still works
macOS only, as a menu-bar app
Terminal support is limited to Terminal, iTerm2 and Ghostty as named on the page
